category_summary: **Hermes Desktop Bot Screen Launch (lead story):** The week's dominant story is the coordinated launch of **[Bot Screen live desktop passthrough](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-4784626f2a61)** for **Hermes Desktop**. **@Teknium**'s [launch announcement](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-4784626f2a61) (~1,150 likes) and **@NousResearch**'s [real-time agent-streaming post](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-ef6b4179c4fa) anchor the wave, with the official **@tonbistudio** [walkthrough + docs](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d84a2bc0a85d) (548 likes) serving as the onboarding path. Sentiment is strongly positive and anticipatory — replies like ['Finallllly!'](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-014ad26a44c6) and a 20k-view ['Much needed!'](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-48968e1c836e) signal this was a long-requested capability landing exactly as hoped. **oh-my-hermes (OMH) Plugin Ecosystem:** **@rlaope** shipped a major **[OMH update adding Jev-Skills and model routing](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-415aecf318f8)** (Jev models/aliases, skills and plugins, workflow routing, fast decisions) and positioned **[OMH as the all-in-one plugin for hermes-agent](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b4d141253a4f)** power users. **Jev Evaluation Tooling:** Alongside the plugin update, **@rlaope** open-sourced **[jeval](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-8530d32deea5)** for Jev model evaluation and visualization, plus **[jev-ask/jev-XYZ skills in oh-my-hermes Updated+](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-99948938337f)** — tangible ecosystem tooling, though the duplicate share saw near-zero engagement. **Official Support & Engagement:** **@Teknium** and **@NousResearch** stayed highly responsive in the replies — pointing a user to **[Hermes via iMessage](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-768697783517)** with any model, [correcting provenance](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-992950038a21) (a tool credited to **Anthropic** is actually built by **Nous Research**), [triaging a reported cache bug](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d5a2f794eeec) with a request for repro steps, and [confirming a community-reported issue was fixed](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-3e1742f36c0b). **Minor chatter:** a lukewarm community [take on Opus 5.5 vs Claude Code](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-797e0ee6c95e) (notable only because **Opus 5.5** GA'd the day before coverage), an open call for [followers to share their GitHub builds](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-921e5927b0af), and assorted hype/emoji replies. Excluded from the ranking: duplicate link drops, vague one-word reactions (['Impressive!'](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-015fe011793b)), and low-substance emoji threads.

You can now watch your agents work live as Hermes Desktop streams the screen of any bot's screen or session in real time.
